mechanism_narrative: Persistently low federal funds rates signal accommodative monetary policy that reduces equity discount rates, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate sustained liquidity support.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.2%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 8.5% indicates severe labor market deterioration that precedes corporate earnings declines, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 8.5%, or Rank IC is negative over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signal broad consumer demand contraction, triggering equity sell-offs and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or Rank IC for interaction term is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Manufacturing output below 90 (INDPRO) indicates severe supply chain disruption and industrial slowdown, reducing corporate profitability and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 90, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained growth in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates strengthening labor market conditions that support consumer spending and corporate earnings, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS increases, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPI inflation exceeding 3.0% signals persistent inflation that may trigger central bank tightening, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL y/y > 3.0%, or Rank IC is negative over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous federal funds rate cuts (FEDFUNDS decline) and unemployment rate increases (UNRATE rise) indicate policy response to economic shock, causing temporary market sell-offs and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines and UNRATE rises, or Rank IC for interaction term is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Annualized GDP growth rate below 0.5% signals economic contraction that reduces corporate earnings visibility, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when GDPC1 growth rate < 0.5% annualized, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
